summary: AuthProvider remains the root identity/session/login provider and no longer receives normalized permissions in frontend auth state.
CapabilityStateProvider is now UI-only and derives sidebar/product UI flags from auth identity and static frontend navigation.
ModuleAccessProvider independently owns module registry and current-user module metadata reads.
AdapterAccessProvider independently owns module adapter registry/access and execution provider registry/access metadata reads.
Provider initialization order is deterministic: AuthProvider -> CapabilityStateProvider -> ModuleAccessProvider -> AdapterAccessProvider.
No provider consumes another non-auth provider, triggers another provider fetch, or cascades refresh.

verification_commands.command: node -e provider import graph check over frontend/src/components/*provider.tsx

verification_commands.notes: Existing tests include stale provider-coupling expectations and unrelated older copy/navigation expectations.
